settings.name: TeamHandoffData
settings.description: What one team leaves for another when a session ends. Most of it exists in separate records today. New here: Offer, Need, and the team fields on Handoff, which connect them.
settings.notes: Sources read 2026-11-06: teams/README.md, teams/teams.json, Episode 568 capability-registry.rispec.md (TeamContract), Episode 560 desk-plot-threads-for-every-episode-261026.md, the connector's record_handoff and propose_session_completion, mia-parallel-code rispecs/task-lifecycle-events.spec.md, pi/miadi-session-observability/HANDOFF-T8.md.

entities.name: Team
entities.description: One of T1 to T8. Exists: teams/teams.json. Makes and Uses are prose in teams/README.md, and teams.json has no field for them.

attributes.name: agent_lead
attributes.description: T8's is null: a handoff to T8 has no seat to claim it.

entities.name: TeamContract
entities.description: What a team provides and what it needs. Named in Episode 568's capability registry and asked for in teams/README.md section T8. No team has written one.

entities.name: CapabilityRecord
entities.description: One thing a repository provides: a package, CLI, skill, MCP tool, API route or plugin. Exists in the Episode 568 rispec and the repository mapper. A team consumes it whenever it wants, so it has no lifecycle per session.

entities.name: Offer
entities.description: New. One kind of thing a team's session leaves, and for whom. This is what mctgo shows beside the team. A capability is one kind of offer. A plot thread, an answered question or a video is another kind, and the capability registry cannot hold those.
entities.notes:
Draft offers read from the Makes and Uses lines of teams/README.md, 2026-11-06. No team has confirmed these.
T1 -> every team: binding line and restored sessions. Check: a session comes back with its team.
T2 -> T4 and others: an event with an address. Check: anyone can see it arrived or failed.
T3 -> building teams: revision messages and the inventory record. Check: the receiving seat read it back.
T4 -> the people a chart concerns: a chart on Asterion that names its seat. Check: a signed-in writer can steer from it.
T5 -> a person, then the new episode: a staged folder with a foundations packet. Check: the foundation holds.
T6 -> the next team and the audience: notebook and media under a manifest, and what the next team can now do. Check: the media is landed in the episode.
T7 -> the owning team: a question its docs or tools could not answer. Check: the owner answered and the ledger line says so.
T8 -> every team: a released version on the hosts that run it. Check: tests pass and the version is live.

attributes.name: carrier_kind
attributes.description: plot_thread, issue, capability_holding, review, desk_ledger_line, stateloom_system, staged_concept, notebook_media

attributes.name: at_session_end
attributes.description: True: every session on the team owes it. False: only a session whose work made one.

attributes.name: acceptance
attributes.description: What the receiving team checks before it claims.

entities.name: Need
entities.description: New. What a team states it needs. A need with no offer is visible as unmet. T8's README section asks every team for this statement.

entities.name: Session
entities.description: An agent session in a terminal. Exists: one line per event in terminal_bindings.jsonl, with its team and episode.
entities.notes: The binding line's episode cannot decide where a handoff lands. This session's line names Episode 103 with source declared, and that value equals the shell's MIADI_CHRONICLE_PROD_EPISODE. Nobody chose Episode 103 for this work.

entities.name: SessionCompletion
entities.description: How a session ends. Exists: the connector's propose_session_completion. Its result.outputs names what was made and has no field for who it was made for.

entities.name: Handoff
entities.description: One thing left by one session for one team. Exists: the connector's record_handoff, keyed by the five accountable circles. New: from_team, to_team, offer_id, ceremony_id. Circles stay as they are: they say who answers for it, and teams say who does it.

attributes.name: offer_id
attributes.description: New. Null: nothing in the contract covers it, which is itself a finding for both teams.

attributes.name: episode_number
attributes.description: Chosen for this handoff, never copied from the binding line.

attributes.name: ceremony_id
attributes.description: New. The ceremony in which it was said, when there was one.

entities.name: Carrier
entities.description: The record that holds what was left, by its address. Every kind already has an address: miadi-chronicle:<n>/threads.yaml#PTn, owner/repo#n, miadi-review:<uuid>, a path at a commit.

entities.name: Verification
entities.description: One check the leaving session ran, with its command and result. Taken from LandedMetadata.verification[] in mia-parallel-code's task-lifecycle-events spec. HANDOFF-T8.md writes the same thing as prose.

entities.name: StagedConcept
entities.description: A folder in _staging_for_new_episodes, kept by T5. Exists. A new episode starts here, because 'the episode is created only when that foundation holds' and its birth is a person's choice.

entities.name: TalkingCircle
entities.description: The circle an episode is born with (Episode 563). Exists.

entities.name: Ceremony
entities.description: A ceremony held in a circle. Exists. Sessions take part in it, and a handoff can be said in it.

entities.name: PlotThread
entities.description: A thread in an episode's threads.yaml. Exists, with a door that checks each beat's ref. carried_by already names a team.

entities.name: DeskProposal
entities.description: A group of beats proposed for a writer: <episode>/proposals/*.yaml. Exists. The Author's Desk reads it, and accepting it makes a Creative prompt. No team's Makes line holds the desk.
